reserveReview.rationale: The previously reviewed four-contract composition and rounded 25% weights are retained. Exact identity reads at Ethereum block 26088539 (2026-09-30T06:35:47Z) confirm that USD3's BasketHandler quote includes 0xbeef01735c132ada46aa9aa4c54623caa92a64cb and its AssetRegistry maps that token to collateral plugin 0xb1327ead6ab9a1e363c4fc61648bd3131a587e39. The exact Steakhouse USDC V1 vault differs from the tracked V2 share token and remains unlinked. W1R68's sourced sUSDS synchronous native USDS conversion remains unchanged. On 2026-10-03 W2R44 pinned Ethereum block 26115203, hash 0x1b8e8fe59dc6658999fa93a3f1e1a854885dfb8d7eaacf9a8b1c4a10a1d9bee6, timestamp 2026-10-03T23:48:35Z. USD3 main().backingManager() is 0x4b0b3d40b0623f3a9eac09d2e01f592710ee59f0. Sender-bound eth_call redeem(uint256,address,address) for this holder's full balance succeeded on both verified exact contracts: StaticATokenV3LM 0x0adc69041a2b086f8772acce2a754f410f211bed and MetaMorpho 0xbeef01735c132ada46aa9aa4c54623caa92a64cb. Each verified redemption burns the entire submitted position and transfers native USDC synchronously; MetaMorpho's exact market-liquidity checks and StaticAToken's pause/available-liquidity checks were exercised, not assumed. Immediate describes full backing-manager claim realization at this observed state, not a future liquidity guarantee, stressed USD sale, fiat settlement or USD3 holder-redemption throughput. Compound's wrapper-to-Comet-to-USDC path remains unknown. No portfolio weights or composition date are refreshed.
